title: Minimum Swaps to Group All 1s Together
description: Find the minimum number of swaps to group all 1s together in a binary array.
pseudocode:
1. countOnes = sum(data)
2. windowOnes = sum(data[0...countOnes-1])
3. maxWindowOnes = windowOnes
4. for i from 1 to data.length - countOnes:
5.   windowOnes = windowOnes - data[i-1] + data[i+countOnes-1]
6.   maxWindowOnes = max(maxWindowOnes, windowOnes)
7. return countOnes - maxWindowOnes

steps.note: Initial window of size 3 has 2 ones.
Slide window: remove data[0]=1, add data[3]=0. Window ones: 2 - 1 + 0 = 1.
Slide window: remove data[1]=0, add data[4]=1. Window ones: 1 - 0 + 1 = 2.
